title: 2021 AMC 10B Problem 5
statement: The ages of Jonie’s four cousins are distinct single-digit positive integers. Two of the cousins’ ages multiplied together give \(24,\) while the other two multiply to \(30.\) What is the sum of the ages of Jonie’s four cousins?

solutions.text:
The only pair of single-digit positive integers with product \(30\) is \(5,6.\) The single-digit factor pairs of \(24\) are \(3,8\) and \(4,6.\) Because all four ages are distinct, the pair \(4,6\) would repeat the age \(6,\) so the other pair must be \(3,8.\) Thus the ages are \(3,5,6,8,\) whose sum is \(22.\)

Thus, the answer is B .
hints: List the single-digit factor pairs of \(30\) first
The ages are distinct, so exclude any factor pair that reuses an age
